column1: # EPA WARM v16 — Electronics Recycling Emission Factors (US ton / short ton)
**Source:** EPA, *Documentation for Greenhouse Gas Emission and Energy Factors Used in the Waste Reduction Model (WARM) Version 16 — Electronics*, December 2023, EPA-530-R-23-022.
## Net GHG Emissions by Materials Management Option (MTCO2E per Short Ton)
**The KEY multiplier for per-component accounting under VMR0008 / AMS-III.BA.**

**Key implication:** PCB alone accounts for 126.70 tCO2e/ton (more than 21× any other component). High-grade server-board feedstock (30–50% PCB mass) can therefore drive substantial VCUs IF per-component accounting is accepted by VVB.
For a VMR0008 / AMS-III.BA project, the per-tonne base calculation is:
For server boards, plug in ~40% PCB + ~30% copper trace + ~10% ferrous + ~15% plastic + ~5% other:
= ~53.91 MTCO2E/ton raw avoided emissions (server-grade PCB feedstock)
Then apply the VMR0008 upstream displacement discount factor (magnitude TBD) and per-tonne collection/transport/processing emissions to get NET eligible tCO2e.
